en.name: Apple cider, fresh
en.summary: Fresh apple cider keeps 2–3 days at room temperature and 2–3 weeks in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Much of it is unpasteurised, and unpasteurised juice carries a real risk of E. coli and other pathogens — it is not advised for young children, older adults, pregnant women or anyone with a weakened immune system.
en.pantry: 2–3 days is all you get at room temperature, and that figure describes how long the cider stays drinkable rather than how it should be stored. Cider is pressed whole apples, sugar and acid and wild yeast all together, and at room temperature it begins to ferment: it fizzes, the sweetness drops and a cidery smell develops. If the jug is unpasteurised, warmth is also exactly what any pathogens on the fruit would need. Buy it cold, get it home cold, and put it straight in the fridge.
en.fridge: 2–3 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in the sealed jug it came in, on a shelf rather than in the door where the temperature swings. Cold does not sterilise cider — it slows the yeast and the bacteria down, which is why the window is weeks rather than months. Expect sediment to settle and the cider to turn slowly drier and fizzier over that time; shake before pouring. Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the jug, since backwash shortens what is left.
en.freezer: Freezing works well and is what people do with a seasonal glut. Leave headspace, because the liquid expands as it freezes, and expect it to separate and need a good shake after thawing. Thaw it in the fridge rather than on the counter.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen cider in the fridge, never at room temperature, and shake it well before pouring. Drink it within the refrigerated window once it has thawed.
spoilage: Fizzing, foaming or a pressurised jug — fermentation has started.
An alcoholic, vinegary or sharply sour smell.
Visible mould at the neck of the jug or on the surface.
Thick, slimy or ropey texture when poured.
tips: Check the label for the word pasteurised if anyone vulnerable will be drinking it.
Keep it on a fridge shelf, not in the door.
Pour into a glass instead of drinking from the jug.
Freeze a seasonal glut in portions with headspace, and thaw in the fridge.

faq.q: How long does fresh apple cider last in the fridge?
faq.a: 2–3 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in its sealed jug. At room temperature it is only good for 2–3 days.
It carries a real risk of E. coli and other pathogens. Health authorities advise against it for young children, older adults, pregnant women and anyone immunocompromised.

faq.q: My cider has gone fizzy. Is it still drinkable?
faq.a: Fizzing means it has begun to ferment. It is no longer the drink you bought, and a sour, vinegary or alcoholic smell means it goes down the sink.

zh.name: 新鮮蘋果原汁
zh.summary: 新鮮蘋果原汁在室溫下只能放 2～3 天，放 4 °C 以下冷藏則是 2～3 週。這類產品很多是未經殺菌的，而未殺菌果汁確實帶有大腸桿菌等病原菌的風險——不建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦，以及免疫力較弱的人飲用。
zh.pantry: 室溫下就是 2～3 天，而這個數字講的是它還能不能喝，而不是「應該這樣存放」。蘋果原汁就是整顆蘋果榨出來的東西：糖、酸、野生酵母全在裡面，放在室溫下它會開始發酵——起氣泡、甜度下降、出現酒酸味。如果那一瓶是未殺菌的，溫暖也正好是果實表面任何病原菌需要的條件。請買冷的、冷著帶回家，一進門就放冰箱。
zh.fridge: 連同原瓶密封，放 4 °C 以下 2～3 週，並且放層架上而不是溫度起伏大的冰箱門邊。低溫不會把蘋果汁殺菌——它只是把酵母和細菌拖慢，所以窗口是以週計而不是以月計。這段期間會沉澱，甜度也會慢慢下降、氣泡漸多；倒之前搖一搖。請倒進杯子喝，不要對著瓶口喝，口水回流會縮短剩下那些的壽命。
zh.freezer: 冷凍是可行的，產季一次拿到大量的人也都這麼做，但要留膨脹空間，並預期解凍後會分層、需要搖勻。請用冷藏解凍，不要放在檯面上退冰。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放室溫，倒之前搖勻。解凍後請在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 起泡、冒沫，或瓶身鼓脹——發酵已經開始。
有酒味、醋味或明顯的酸敗味。
倒出來變得濃稠、黏滑或牽絲。
tips: 如果有體質較弱的人要喝，先確認標示上是否寫了「殺菌」。
放冰箱層架，不要放門邊。
倒進杯子喝，不要對瓶口喝。
產季大量的話，分裝留膨脹空間冷凍，並用冷藏解凍。

faq.q: 新鮮蘋果原汁冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 原瓶密封放 4 °C 以下 2～3 週。室溫下只有 2～3 天。

faq.q: 未殺菌的蘋果原汁安全嗎？
faq.a: 它確實帶有大腸桿菌等病原菌的風險。衛生主管機關建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦與免疫力較弱者不要飲用。

faq.q: 蘋果汁有氣泡了還能喝嗎？
faq.a: 起泡代表它開始發酵，已經不是你買的那個飲料了。有酸味、醋味或酒味就倒掉。

faq.q: 夏天沒喝完的蘋果原汁放在桌上，隔天就冒泡了是正常的嗎？
faq.a: 那是發酵，不是正常。汁裡本來就有蘋果帶進來的野生酵母，室溫 2～3 天那個數字講的是涼爽的室內，台灣夏天三十幾度會快得多，一個下午就夠它起泡、變酸、甜度掉下來。如果那一瓶是未殺菌的，同樣的溫度也正好是果實表面病原菌需要的條件，所以起泡的就整瓶倒掉，不要煮過再喝。買冷的、冷著帶回家，進門就放 4 °C 以下的層架，不要放冰箱門邊。
